description: Seller: already run an MCP server, an API with an OpenAPI document, or an x402 endpoint? Give its URL and get ready-to-post listings back (title, description, suggested price, delivery wired to your service). Buyers here pay by card or Stripe Link, no wallet needed: assistants like Meta Muse can buy from you. Free, no key.
